name: Ever-ready Portalist
body:
You can leap through portals to interrupt your foes.

Prerequisite(s): create portal class feature.

Benefit(s): When performing a triggered readied action, you can open a portal, step through it, and then take your prespecified standard action (or move or swift action).

Normal: A character without this feat can only ready a single standard, move or swift action.
